entities.summary: Nelly Mbangu is a Congolese women's and children's rights campaigner. She co-founded a movement to bring together 30 organisations with similar aims under title Sauti ya Mama Mukongomani. She is a woman human rights defender and the coordinator of the Help and Action for Piece - Aide et Action pour la Paix (AAP). Additionally Help and Action for Piece - Aide et Action pour la Paix (AAP) works on good governance topics and resolution of land rights disputes.
